name: io.github.Cygnux-Labs/tracekit-mcp-gateway
title: Tracekit MCP gateway
description: MCP proxy: a Tracekit signer decides and signs each tool call. Needs a running signer and a config.

runtimeArguments.name: --with
runtimeArguments.description: the MCP Python SDK the gateway connects to its upstream servers with

packageArguments.name: --config
packageArguments.description: mcp-gateway.yaml: its HTTPS listener, the Tracekit signer it reaches and the upstream MCP servers

headers.name: X-Tracekit-Run
headers.description: <run_id>.<run_token> of the agent's run, from register_run on the signer

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>: the agent's identity, when the gateway's http.authenticators accept a bearer or Kubernetes service account token (else a client certificate)
